excluded_fields.hadiths.matn / hadiths.matn_no: hukm label per report, coded 0-8 on hadithdb's own scale; no grader is named
excluded_fields.meaning_groups.matn_no / tarafs.matn: overall hukm per meaning group, computed across chains
excluded_fields.rawis.rank / rawis.rank_no: one rank wording per narrator with no critic named (Taqrib-like wording, unattributed)
excluded_fields.sanads.hukum: templated sentence assembled from narrator rank wording ('إسناد ضعيف فيه X وهو ضعيف الحديث'); no grader named
excluded_fields.sanads.matn / sanads.matn_no: hukm label per chain; equals a function of the chain's weakest narrator rank (max_rank) and continuity
excluded_fields.sanads.max_rank: weakest narrator's rank number in the chain, computed by the source

hadith_kg.how_told_apart: A grading is kept only when the dataset names who said it. hadith-kg's report and chain labels name no grader; every hukum sentence is built from one of a few frames around narrator rank wording; and the chain label is determined by the weakest narrator rank (contingency table chain_label_by_weakest_rank), i.e. computed.

riwayat.conclusion: No report grading and no critic statement is stored. Narrator fields (tradition, madhhab, tabaqa, death_year) and identification confidences are the corpus's own labels or model outputs, not verdicts; nothing is taken from Riwayat.
